text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening, as Curren Chan led me through
the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah! They're already at it~♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother, let's do the lottery raffle♪
Curren has tickets!"
choice_data_list: You went to the shopping district for that?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, let's do the lottery raffle♪
Curren has tickets!
choice_data_list: You went to the shopping district for that?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe, actually, you see♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to share the excitement
of the raffle with you, Big Brother♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to share the thrill of the
raffle draw together with you, big sis / big brother♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Also, I wanted you to film the part
where I spun the raffle wheel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Curren Chan, having material for a social media post
seems more important than the prize itself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm talking about♪
Big Bro, get your phone ready, ready♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's what I'm talking about♪
Big Sis, get your phone ready, ready♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan cutely gripped the raffle handle...
Building suspense, building it, building it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd be boring if I spun it right away♪
Here goes, then~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Spun it!
And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what a shocker~
Who would've thought we'd hit the grand prize?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
For good visual appeal, I was thinking maybe
a mountain of carrots, but~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is just so cute,
maybe it got drawn in♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, taking it for granted that she'd pull 2nd prize
or higher is so very Curren Chan...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So here, this ticket is
a present for you, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So here, this ticket is
a present for you, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren got a great video, so she's satisfied♪
Consider this a thank-you for tagging along.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'd be glad if it gives you a chance to unwind, Big Brother.
Feel free to go whenever you'd like, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'd love it if it helps you unwind, Big Sis.
Feel free to go whenever you want, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She gives her all to obtain what she desires, but doesn't care much
about things acquired by chance... That's so like Curren Chan. But—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~?
Too late, I already gave it away~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If you can catch up to Curren, sure!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Alright, ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, running as hard as I might,
there was naturally no way I could catch up—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Good work, Big Brother!
Too bad for you, though—Curren won!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Great job, big sis!
Too bad for you though, Curren wins!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, you really ran your heart out.
Just like you, Big Brother, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, you really ran your heart out.
Just like you, Big Sister, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's a chance to get some good rest without Curren around, so you should just take it.
choice_data_list: Curren's the one who really needs a break.
Curren's the one who really needs a break, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had a tendency to shoulder things alone on a daily basis.
I conveyed my wish for her to carve out some time to catch her breath...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...I see,
so it was all for Curren's sake, huh."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Big Brother, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Seriously, big sis...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Curren gives up.
Being loved this much might actually be a problem~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Once everything is finished and we reach a milestone...
let's go together♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I decided to hold onto
the "Hot Springs Trip Ticket" for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yayâª
It's extra special grade!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, since it's premium quality,
it might be a waste to just make hamburger steaks.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "If we're going all out, let's make it feel like a party and pile on all the premium stuff♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So with that said...
let's look around the shopping street a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren wants accessories and stuff too.
...Ah.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Onii-chan,
do you like cooking?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Onee-chan,
do you like cooking?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Just small talk, you know?
Curren, well~..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I guess I just come to like it
whenever the need arises♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren wants to try
Onii-chan's home cooking.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren wants to try
Onee-chan's home cooking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we went back to the academy
and held a deluxe carrot hamburg steak party, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, I had become the chef, serving and entertaining Curren Chan myself...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!
That really is a massive heap.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
With a harvest festival vibe,
decorating wooden crates would really make a complete set♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And an orange-themed outfit... 
Yep, looks perfect!
choice_data_list: Was this your goal right from the start?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, it was just a coincidence~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I just happened to know that the carrots from the lottery
are crazy sweet and have a suuuper pretty orange color, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should ask Onii-chan to help me
shoot some photos once we get back?
choice_data_list: Yeah, as the one taking the pictures?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should ask Onee-chan to help me
shoot some photos once we get back?
choice_data_list: Yeah, as the one taking the pictures?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No.
Not that way...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'#AllCarrotsUsedInThisShoot
WereDelightfullyFinishedByTheStaff'

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...One stick.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Just now?
I was just lost in thought for a second.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: How to make the most of this one stick... Well, I've already made up my mind♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hold a carrot up to your cheek...
All right, say cheese♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Now everything's perfect♪
I'll call it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
'#CarrotChallenge
#Carrots #ActuallyPhotogenic
#CuteCurrenChan'

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I'll roast the carrots whole.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, sparked by Curren Chan's post,
the '#CarrotChallenge' trended on Umastagram for a while.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, well it can't be helped~.
It's a lottery, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Curren was thinking of doing some shopping on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking it's about time
to replace my makeup brushes for shoots.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Including spares,
maybe I should restock around a hundred.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother, do you still have time?
Could you hang out with me a little longer?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, do you still have time?
Would you mind hanging out with me a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides,
it means we'll get to spin the raffle about 100 times...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I desperately tried to pacify Curren Chan
when her competitive streak flared up...
and managed to settle things by promising her a date.
